openings.claim: Unverified removable jaws replace strap tension with bolted reaction and pad friction. Each of two assemblies uses paired aluminum strips above hatch/below accessible rim, two outboard bolts and two rubber pads preventing direct metal contact. Drill only strips; loosen bolts without removing nuts and slide jaws completely away. Cord bundles assemblies/pads outside opening. Technician fabricates, adjusts, collects, counts and inspects; each cycle checks nuts, pad wear and contact positions.
openings.discriminator: Modest balanced preload may reduce lateral motion below 1 mm without opposite-corner lift. Rival: tighten these jaws at the left corner, attributing retention to greater local compression. Compare lateral displacement, opposite-corner lift and seal damage; balanced-pressure hypothesis fails if useful retention requires rival rocking preload.
openings.probe: Measure rim accessibility, bolt reach and jaw overlap first; abandon if fixture alteration or permanent deformation is required. Fabricate only if dimensions fit within 90 minutes; observation budget is 20 minutes. Run ten candidate opening/closure/20 N pull trials; time every reopening and measure position/corner lift. Disturb final candidate closure with supplied 1 mm right-contact card. Run two rival diagnostics, one disturbed: twelve total trials, two configurations maximum. Rival diagnostics cannot establish ten-cycle durability. Inspect seal every trial; terminate on new tears. Record recoverability, full opening clearance, final 20 N resistance and reopening time.
openings.uncertainty: Indispensable underside accessibility and sufficient bolt length are unspecified. Strip stiffness/pad friction may be inadequate; rim geometry may prevent sliding removal. Disturbance may redistribute pressure and defeat alignment despite undisturbed passes.

lineage.reason: Jaw relation, rival/defeat, bounded tests, maintenance, stopping caveats and uncertain fit retained.

decision: Proceed only as bounded probe; feasibility/performance unverified. Preserve hatch/rim/seal: no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation; no powered joint; recoverable parts; unobstructed opening; no new seal tears. After ten cycles require position within 1 mm, 20 N resistance and one-technician reopening within 30 seconds. Disturbed closure retains all requirements except seal-contact continuity.
